ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGLOAD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog load register. Writing this register sets the initial value for the countdown timer. The counter will start counting down from this value. This register can be written multiple times to reset the countdown. Writing to this register when the lock register is locked (WDOGLOCK != 0x1ACCE551) is ignored.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WDOG_LOAD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Watchdog decrement timer reload value. Sets the initial value for the countdown timer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGVALUE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog value register. This register shows the current value of the watchdog counter. It is read-only and reflects the current countdown value. Register writes are ignored. This register is volatile as its value changes during operation.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_READ
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The current value of watchdog counter. Hardware-updated value that shows the current countdown value.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGCONTROL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog control register. Controls the decrement step value and enables reset/interrupt generation. Writing to this register when locked (WDOGLOCK != 0x1ACCE551) is ignored. Writing INTEN=1 reloads counter from WDOGLOAD if it was previously disabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STEP_VALUE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Step value for the counter. Configures the clock division rate: 000=÷1, 001=÷2, 010=÷4, 011=÷8, 100=÷16. Values other than 0-4 are invalid.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable watchdog reset output (WDOGRES). Acts as a mask for the reset output. Set to 1 to enable the reset, or to 0 to disable the reset. Only affects behavior on the second timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable the interrupt event (WDOGINT). Set to 1 to enable the counter and the interrupt. Reloads the counter from the value in WDOGLOAD when the interrupt is enabled after previously being disabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved bits. Reads return 0. Writing to these bits has no effect.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGINTCLR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog interrupt clear register. Writing any value to this register clears the watchdog interrupt signal and reloads the counter from the WDOGLOAD register. Writing to this register when locked (WDOGLOCK != 0x1ACCE551) is ignored. Write-only register, reading returns 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INT_CLR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write any value to this field to clear interrupt and reload counter from WDOGLOAD.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGRIS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog raw interrupt status register. This register indicates the raw interrupt status from the counter, without masking. Reading this register returns the current raw interrupt status. Writing to this register has no effect.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAW_WDOG_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Raw interrupt status from the counter. 1 when counter has reached zero, 0 otherwise.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved bits. Reads return 0. Writing to these bits has no effect.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGMIS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog masked interrupt status register. This register shows the masked interrupt status, which is the logical AND of WDOGRIS and INTEN. It reflects the actual interrupt signal state (WDOGRIS bit 0 AND INTEN bit 0).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WDOG_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable interrupt status from the counter. This is the logical AND of WDOGRIS[0] and WDOGCONTROL[0], representing the actual interrupt output signal.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved bits. Reads return 0. Writing to these bits has no effect.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGLOCK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog lock register. Controls write access to all other registers. Writing 0x1ACCE551 enables write access to all other registers. Writing any other value disables write access to all other registers. Reading returns 0x00000000 if unlocked (0x1ACCE551 written), 0x00000001 if locked (any other value written).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WDOG_LOCK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable write access to all other registers by writing 0x1ACCE551. Disable write access by writing any other value. A read returns the lock status: 0x0 when write access is enabled (unlocked), 0x1 when write access is disabled (locked).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGITCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog integration test control register. Controls whether the device operates in integration test mode. In integration test mode, direct control of interrupt and reset outputs is possible through WDOGITOP register. Writing to this register when locked (WDOGLOCK != 0x1ACCE551) is ignored.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INT_TEST_MODE_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Integration test mode enable. 1 = enter integration test mode, 0 = operate in normal decrement counting mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved bits. Reads return 0. Writing to these bits has no effect.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: WDOGITOP
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Watchdog integration test output register. In integration test mode, this register allows direct control of interrupt and reset outputs. Writing to this register when locked (WDOGLOCK != 0x1ACCE551) is ignored. This register has no effect when not in integration test mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WDOGINT_VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Integration test mode WDOGINT value. Direct control of the interrupt output during integration test mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WDOGRES_VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Integration test mode WDOGRES value. Direct control of the reset output during integration test mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved bits. Reads return 0. Writing to these bits has no effect.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: wclk
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: Working clock input for the timer operation. The timer operates on wclk rising edges when wclk_en is high.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: wclk_en
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: Clock enable for the working clock domain. Timer operates only when wclk_en is high.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: wrst_n
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: Working clock domain reset, active-low asynchronous reset. Resets all registers to default values and stops counter.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: prst_n
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: APB bus reset signal, active-low asynchronous reset. Resets all registers to default values.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: wdogint
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: Watchdog interrupt signal, edge-triggered. Generated when counter reaches zero and INTEN=1. Remains asserted until cleared by writing to WDOGINTCLR.

ipxact:port.ipxact:name: wdogres
ipxact:port.ipxact:description: Watchdog reset signal, edge-triggered. Generated when counter reaches zero twice consecutively with RESEN=1. Remains asserted until system reset.
